meta.description: Twelve sneaking Configurator clicks in a row on the same face, per machine, mode and face (north is the front, up is the top).
meta.fields: marks [machine, mode, face, click N]; machine; mode; face; click (1..12); relative_side; supported (whether the machine supports the transmission type of the mode); data_type (the DataType of that side for the mode's transmission type after the click, null when unsupported or the mode is not a configure mode); result, menu, overlay, chat, payloads as in configurator_click_*; config_after (config of every transmission type after the click); block (still the same machine).
